To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) DSSMs are often not learning the underlying dynamics, (ii) a constrained optimisation approach can be used to train DSSMs, (iii) the resulting models achieve better system identification and prediction results, (iv) a combination of amortised variational filtering and smoothing leads to a more accurate model of the dynamics, (v) our approach is able to disentangle static and dynamic features in the learned representation.
